memories.value: This project uses a repo-level venv at .venv (Python 3.14) containing fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pytest, httpx and playwright==1.62.0. Run the backend with '.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000' from backend/, and tests with 'cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest'.

The frontend dev server is pinned to http://127.0.0.1:5273 (strictPort, host 127.0.0.1) because 127.0.0.1:5173 is already used by an unrelated project (H:\AiAgentTest_crew) on this machine. On the default port Vite binds IPv6-only and 127.0.0.1:5173 serves the wrong application.

Playwright is pinned to 1.62.0 in .venv so it shares the browser builds already installed at C:\Users\LIN\AppData\Local\ms-playwright (chromium-1234). Headed Chromium launches successfully in this environment; do NOT install a different Playwright version without reinstalling browsers.

The backend suite is 'cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest' (57 tests, ~64s). It launches a real headed Chromium for the browser tests, and pytest's summary line only appears when output is redirected to a file rather than piped to grep.

The project is tracked at https://github.com/xiaoLin12130/coding-agent.git on branch main. Push with 'git push origin main' (Windows git 2.54 with Git Credential Manager 2.7.3, stored account xiaoLin12130). A stray empty clone of this same repo exists at ./coding-agent/ - it is untracked and breaks 'git add -A'; prefer explicit paths or delete that directory.
